parsed.summary: To obtain a duplicate family booklet after loss, you must submit a request to the civil status officer of the arrondissement where the marriage was contracted, along with specific personal documents and the applicable fee.

steps.action: Write a formal request addressed to the officer of civil status of the arrondissement where the marriage contract was concluded, stating the loss of the family booklet and requesting a duplicate.
Attach a copy of the head‑of‑family’s identity card (CIN).
Attach the marriage certificate (extrait de l’acte de mariage).
Attach birth certificates (extraits de naissance) of both spouses.

steps.when: If the booklet is to be issued to the mother after the spouse’s death
steps.action: Attach the death certificate of the deceased spouse.

steps.when: If the mother has custody after a divorce
steps.action: Attach the divorce judgment (expédition du jugement de divorce).

steps.when: If there are other family members
steps.action: Attach birth certificates of the other family members (children, etc.).
Pay the required fee (redevance) for the family booklet and submit the complete dossier to the civil status office.
